title: 第21章 欺骗本王让你做花倌第22章 皇子的粗布麻衣
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
樱儿，樱儿，名字叫起来很亲昵。
樱落心里为齐瀚对她的称呼窃喜着。
“喂，接着说你的身世啊，还没说完呢。”
齐煜的眉眼看起来有些冷漠，声音听上去也冰冷冷的。
樱落见两人对自己说的故事十分感兴趣，证明她编造的还不错，心里有些得意。
于是，她装作楚楚可怜的样子，接着又说道：
“到我蹒跚学步，牙牙学语的时候，我便与普通的孩童不一样，那时的我便能使用巫术，胡爷爷同我讲，只要我一吹奏叶子，便会引来许多鸟儿围绕着我转。直到我长大之后，才发现自己会的是巫术，之后渐渐学会了用竹笛来召唤青鸾鸟，到如今这般熟练。”
“那后来呢，天女的预言又是何缘故？”齐瀚问。
樱落回答：“其实我小时候，身上是有一个神秘信物的。”
说完，她便拿出了装有樱花扇的香囊。
红色的香囊上面，绣着“天女降世，得令天下”的预言。
“殿下请看——这个香囊上面便绣有天女的预言，只不过花婆婆认为，这个预言半真半假，最终会给我带来灾难，所以藏了起来。或许这便是天意呢，直到近日香囊重新拿出，预言也就传了出去，樱落也终于等来了两位殿下……”
“哦？”
齐煜不可置信的挑了挑眉。
“这些话听起来天衣无缝，实际上却值得推敲，怎么有人生来便会巫术呢？我不信。”
樱落只好解释说：“哎？身世我是真的不知道，不过胡爷爷说我是从落花河中被冲流过来的，或许来自开阳国的人也说不定？可既然爹娘选择抛弃了我，那我从今以后，便是天玑国的子民。”
因为开阳国的人擅长鬼神巫术，而这几个月以来，天玑国又久攻不破那西边的开阳国。
这样的身世足以证明，樱落的巫术不是空穴来巢，而是天生便会的。
“本王希望你说的这些都是真的，若胆敢欺骗……”
齐煜突然凑近樱落，用手抬了抬她的下巴，那双如黑曜石般的眼睛看得樱落直发悚。

“我在皇城中正好有个花馆，叫群芳楼，看你才艺不佳，但姿容尚可。既然这么会编故事，勉强让你去做个花倌，陪宾客消遣，遭世人羞辱，让你知道欺骗本王的下场！”
此时，樱落正在将一块茶点送入嘴中。
听他这样说，差点被噎到，咳了好半天才缓了过来。
这个齐煜，不但嘴巴特毒，内心还禽兽不如！
花倌也能想出来？
真是瞎了他气质翩翩，风华绝代的模样……
可齐煜偏偏就喜欢戏弄樱落，和她斗斗嘴。
大概是“棋逢对手”吧，樱落也不是嘴笨，坐以待毙的主。
看着她气鼓鼓和狼狈咳嗽的模样，齐煜嘴角不自觉勾起了一抹难以察觉的笑意。
和樱落相处的这几日以来，齐煜渐渐发现，眼前的女子与其他宫中女子有所不同。
不单单是因为她擅长巫术，口舌伶俐的原因。
然而具体是什么原因呢？
连齐煜自己也不清楚……
“五弟，不是孤说你，你这未免说得有些太过分了……樱落她好歹是个女孩子吧。”
齐瀚在一旁努力劝和着。
毕竟去往皇城的路途遥远，他可不想见两人针锋相对，这一路上耳边都不得清净。
樱落不情不愿的拿起手帕，仔仔细细的给自己的嘴角擦了个干净。
然后又给自己倒了一杯茶水，仰头一饮而尽。
等放下茶杯后，她突然微微一笑，眸光里气定神闲，波澜不惊。
“太子殿下，不必为了我伤了和气，我樱落大度，自然是不会将五皇子的玩笑当真计较的，你说是吧，五皇子殿下？”
content_en:
Ying'er, Ying'er, the name sounds very affectionate.
Yingluo was secretly happy at what Qi Han called her.
"Hey, go on and tell me about your life experience, I'm not done yet."
Qi Yu's eyebrows looked a little cold, and his voice sounded cold.
Yingluo felt a little proud when she saw that the two of them were very interested in the story she told, which proved that she had made it well.
So, she pretended to be pitiful, and then said:
"When I was a toddler and learning to speak, I was different from ordinary children. At that time, I was able to use witchcraft. Grandpa Hu told me that as long as I played the leaves, many birds would surround me. It wasn't until I grew up that I discovered that I knew witchcraft. Then I gradually learned to use a bamboo flute to summon the green luan bird, and I am now so proficient in it."
"Then what happened next, what was the reason for the goddess' prophecy?" Qi Han asked.
Yingluo replied: "Actually, when I was a child, I had a mysterious token on my body."
After saying that, she took out the sachet containing the cherry blossom fan.
On the red sachet, there is a prophecy embroidered on it: "The goddess will come to the world and rule the world."
"Your Highness, please take a look - this sachet is embroidered with the prophecy of the goddess of heaven. However, Granny Hua believed that this prophecy was half true and half false, and would eventually bring disaster to me, so she hid it. Perhaps this was God's will. Until recently, when the sachet was taken out again, the prophecy was spread, and Yingluo finally waited for the two highnesses..."
"Oh?"
Qi Yu raised his eyebrows in disbelief.
"These words sound perfect, but they are actually worthy of scrutiny. How can someone be born with witchcraft? I don't believe it."
Yingluo had no choice but to explain: "Huh? I really don't know my life experience, but Grandpa Hu said that I was washed away from the Luohua River. Maybe someone from the Kaiyang Kingdom? But since my parents chose to abandon me, from now on, I will be a citizen of the Tianji Kingdom."
Because the people of Kaiyang Kingdom are good at ghosts and witchcraft, and in the past few months, Tianji Kingdom has been unable to attack the Kaiyang Kingdom to the west.
This kind of life experience is enough to prove that Yingluo's witchcraft is not something that comes out of nowhere, but is something she is born with.
"I hope what you said is true. If you dare to deceive..."
Qi Yu suddenly approached Ying Luo and lifted her chin with his hand. Those obsidian eyes made Ying Luo tremble.
"I happen to have a flower pavilion in the imperial city called Qunfang Pavilion. I see that your talent is not good, but your appearance is acceptable. Since you are so good at making up stories, I reluctantly let you be a flower girl, entertaining guests, and being humiliated by the world. Let you know the consequences of deceiving me!"
At this time, Yingluo was putting a piece of tea into her mouth.
Hearing what he said, I almost choked and coughed for a long time before I recovered.
This Qi Yu not only has a very poisonous mouth, but also feels worse than a beast in his heart!
Can the flower girl figure it out?
It’s really blinding to his elegant and unparalleled appearance...
But Qi Yu just likes to tease Ying Luo and bicker with her.
It's probably because "you meet your opponent", Yingluo is not a stupid person who just sits there and waits for death.
Seeing her angry and embarrassed cough, Qi Yu's lips unconsciously evoked an imperceptible smile.
After spending the past few days with Yingluo, Qi Yu gradually discovered that the woman in front of him was different from other women in the palace.
Not just because she is good at witchcraft and has a sharp tongue.
But what is the specific reason?
Even Qi Yu himself doesn't know...
"Fifth brother, I am not just talking about you, you are going too far... Yingluo is a girl after all."
Qi Han tried his best to persuade.
After all, it was a long way to the imperial city, and he didn't want to see the two of them confronting each other, and his ears would not be clean along the way.
Yingluo reluctantly picked up the handkerchief and carefully wiped the corners of her mouth clean.
Then he poured himself another cup of tea and drank it in one gulp.
After putting down the tea cup, she suddenlyRan smiled slightly, his eyes calm and calm.
"Your Highness, there is no need to hurt your friendship because of me. I, Ying Luo, am generous and will naturally not take the fifth prince's jokes seriously. Don't you think so, your highness, the fifth prince?"
